title: Confronting Workplace Discrimination
paragraphs: Hassan menyadari bahwa keputusan promosi di perusahaannya tampak kurang jelas. Beberapa rekan yang berkualifikasi, termasuk beberapa perempuan, memiliki pertanyaan tentang penilaian kinerja mereka. Sebelum membuat asumsi, ia berbicara secara pribadi dengan rekan kerja dan memeriksa proses promosi yang diterbitkan. Lalu ia mengumpulkan contoh serta pertanyaan yang spesifik.

Hassan menyampaikan persoalan itu melalui jalur resmi perusahaan. Ia berfokus pada kriteria yang jelas dan komunikasi yang adil, bukan menyalahkan orang tertentu. Tanggapan awal cukup hati-hati, tetapi kemudian perusahaan menjelaskan prosesnya dengan lebih jelas. Hassan belajar bahwa pertanyaan profesional yang didukung bukti dapat membantu memperbaiki tempat kerja.
answerKey: Hassan noticed that promotion decisions in his company seemed unclear. Some qualified colleagues, including several women, had questions about how their performance was being assessed. Before making assumptions, he spoke privately with colleagues and reviewed the published promotion process. He then gathered specific examples and questions. Hassan raised the issue through the company's formal channel. He focused on clear criteria and fair communication rather than blaming particular people. The first response was cautious, but the company later explained its process more clearly. Hassan learned that a professional question, supported by evidence, can help improve a workplace.
